feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 May 2026 7:35am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 17 May 2026 at 7:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Scotland as various troughs approach from the west of Ireland.


##Wind##

West or west-southwest, soon backing southwest, 4 or 5, decreasing 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then showers arriving, becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 2 to 4, backing south or southeast 3 to 5 in the evening, backing southeast 5 to 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, rain arriving later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in the rain later.
